[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-i0[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]just install-all: a wait worth sitting through[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]`just install-all` (and plain `just install`) stop looking hung [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]during their long bob-cli and Bob Mac Capture builds. All three [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]repos are pulled first, then one fit-to-screen "What's new" digest [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]shows the commits since each repo's last successful install on this[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]host, with full messages when they fit. Each build then runs behind[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]one live status line: activity, elapsed time, and an ETA that only [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]per-host history of comparable builds can earn. Compiler chatter [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]goes to a log, failures print an excerpt, and the run ends with a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]summary, a terminal bell, and on macOS a Notification Center [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]banner. A missing or failing helper always falls back to today's [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]behavior.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]7[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202611/install_all_wait_and_whats_new.md[/#87AFFF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]install_ui package core, state store, and script test harness[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]ui-core[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ui-core: create the stdlib Python 3.9 `scripts/lib/install_ui/` package [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](entry point, term.py, state.py, watermark subcommands), the bash [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]3.2-safe `scripts/lib/install_ui.sh` loader, bob-cli watermark recording[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]in `just install`, and a unittest suite with portability gates wired [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]into `just check-scripts`.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]What's new digest engine[/bold #D7AFFF]                                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]digest-engine[dim] · [dim][/dim]after ui-core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]digest-engine: implement `install_ui digest`. It resolves ranges from [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the install watermark, extracts commits, strips SASE trailers, groups by[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Conventional Commit type, chooses the richest of four levels that fits [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the screen, and renders the section plus a digest.json record. Tests use[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]real temp Git repos.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Live status line runner and build history[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]live-runner[dim] · [dim][/dim]after ui-core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]live-runner: implement `install_ui run`. It is the single-writer live [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]status line around a child build, with Cargo and SwiftPM phase parsers, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]a chatter filter, logs, a failure excerpt, signal-safe cleanup, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]change-kind prediction, runs.jsonl recording, and the learning and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]last-similar-build ETA rungs. `record` and `kind` subcommands round it [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]out. Tests run under real PTYs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Pull everything first, print the digest, end with a signal[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]pull-first-run[dim] · [dim][/dim]after digest-engine[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]pull-first-run: restructure scripts/install_all to pull all three repos [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]up front, show aligned pull rows in the header, carry full SHAs across [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the self-re-exec (with the legacy upgrade path), print the digest, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]advance sibling watermarks. It also drops the nested INSTALL banner and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]adds the bell and macOS completion banner. Includes an end-to-end [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sandbox harness.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Route builds and plugin sync through the live line[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]quiet-builds[dim] · [dim][/dim]after live-runner, pull-first-run[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]quiet-builds: run the bob-cli Cargo build (in `just install`) and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Mac Capture install (after a TTY signing preflight) through the live [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]runner with a started-file fallback. Quiet the plugin sync per DECISIONS[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]plugin_diffs, add install-all -v/--verbose and BOB_INSTALL_VERBOSE, make[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Ctrl-C stop the run cleanly, and extend the end-to-end tests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Earned ETA ranges, plan line, and comparative summary[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]earned-eta[dim] · [dim][/dim]after quiet-builds[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]earned-eta: complete the estimator ladder (p20-p80 range after 5 [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]consistent samples, a bar anchored to the slow end, "taking longer than [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]usual"), add the pre-build plan line and the summary's "about usual" [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]comparison, and replay a compact digest in the summary only when the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]digest scrolled off.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Docs refresh and real-terminal acceptance[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]docs-acceptance[dim] · [dim][/dim]after earned-eta[/#AF87FF][/dim]
